copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 它会自动把 Webex 的连接插件复制到项目里、登记进频道列表、装好配套程序,并运行一次检查确认一切就绪。之后还需你手动创建 Webex 机器人并填入令牌,它才能收到消息。
howto.when: 当你说要添加或接入 Cisco Webex 频道,在 /setup 流程中要求配置渠道,或运行 /manage-channels 时。

say.text: 帮我接入 Webex 频道
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册渠道

say.text: 添加 Cisco Webex 集成
say.note: 会安装依赖并运行测试

say.text: 配置 Webex 机器人令牌
say.note: 引导你粘贴令牌和 webhook 密钥

howto.what_en: It copies the Webex adapter into the project, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, and runs build and integration tests to verify. You still need to create a Webex bot and provide its token and webhook secret manually for it to receive messages.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add or integrate Cisco Webex, request channel configuration during the /setup flow, or run /manage-channels.

say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and registering it
Installs the dependency and runs tests
